title: M5's three page files: the health page, the support session, the data step
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's local tests on the test console with a stand-in backend; no real box

findings.claim: the console declared three M5 page files (health_page, data_step, support_page) that no branch had: the health page, the support session and the data step were off on every box, and F0's test passed because they stood in its PENDING set
findings.fix: this card: the three pages built, PENDING emptied, the routes on rc1's allowed list

findings.claim: M3's page /admin/egress is not on rc1_guard.ALLOWED, so on a refused box (PRODUCTION) the administrator's page 'What left this box' is refused as a live patient list; found while adding M5's routes, not changed here
findings.fix: for the integrator: rule whether the egress record page is allowed on a refused box

findings.claim: no service records how long a model call takes: the health page's model latency line is the wall time of the jobs that called a model over their calls, an upper bound; and the console's audit reader keeps an ingest's totals only, so the data step reads the night's counts per type from the chain itself
findings.fix: a per-call time in the orchestrator's job metrics would make the line exact
